name: Land Cruiser FJ56
body_style: 4-door station wagon, 2,700mm wheelbase - same body as FJ55
notes: JDM-only chassis code Toyota assigned to the FJ55 body once it got the 2F engine in 1975 - export markets kept calling it FJ55. A naming distinction, not a mechanically different model - treat as identical to the post-1975 FJ55.
